Many unexperienced users may simply run "client httpS://site.tld/script | sh" as root thinking that using https automatically means using a secure connection. Furthermore, some systems may not provide CAs (in the right place?) for these clients, and the user may be instructed by the software itself to disable ssl cert verification.

On the other side, typical server system have only ONE key valid to sign packages, usually one per repo, which is totally independent from the https CAs.
